testimonials.title: What it changes day to day

items.quote: We stopped losing track of who owned what. The automations alone saved our standups.
Docs living next to tasks sounds small until you stop hunting through old messages for context.
Our handoffs between design and engineering finally have a clear, visible trail.
Switching tools used to mean re-training everyone. Flowpilot took a single afternoon.

items.question: How does billing work?
items.answer: You're billed monthly per workspace based on your plan. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time from account settings.

items.question: Can I migrate from another tool?
items.answer: Yes. Flowpilot imports projects and tasks from common formats, and our team can help with larger migrations.

items.question: Is my team's data secure?
items.answer: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with workspace-level permissions controlling who can see what.

items.question: Does Flowpilot work with our existing tools?
items.answer: Flowpilot connects to common calendars, chat tools, and repositories, and supports custom webhooks for anything else.

items.question: Is there a limit on team size?
items.answer: No. Every plan supports unlimited members; plans differ in automation depth, support, and admin controls.
